about: Overlay recipes the release check (scripts/overlay-recipes-check.mjs) lets resolve to a human-only class. Each entry is keyed by the recipe's file and its exact command text as the corpus holds it, and carries the reason it is right or the decision it waits on. An entry no held recipe matches fails the check, so delete it when the recipe or the classifier moves. The CLASS-DIFF (--diff) reads the same entries: a call it would block (a move from auto, sampled or card to human-only or refused against the baseline core) passes when an entry names it with a reason; an optional flip {from, to} narrows the entry to that one move.

entries.reason: OPEN, owner or Carter decides (EDGEOS-BLOCK sweep, agentvillage #427 report). The operator selfie recipe names the Hermes home with --root and has classed policy.core since 0.4.6 (APRV-511, protected-path). Dropping --root would class exec.local but dodges a protected-path rule for a script that reads $HERMES_HOME/.env, so neither the overlay nor core was changed. Listed so the check gates every other recipe; remove it once the recipe or the rule is decided.
